title: Vintage Story Mod Database
description: Current-state facts about mods we track — installed ones and the originals/predecessors of forks we're keeping an eye on. Dated change history does NOT belong here; see AGENTS.md and AgentLogs/. Omit any field below whose value would be null/empty rather than writing it as null.

schema_version.description: Bump when this schema's shape changes.

description.description: Human-readable one-liner about this file's purpose, shown at the top of MOD_DB.json itself.

open_flags.description: Unresolved cross-mod compatibility watch-items that don't belong to a single mod entry. Resolved flags get removed (and moved to a log entry), not kept here.

modid.description: modid from the mod's modinfo.json / mods.vintagestory.at URL slug in the API (e.g. mods.vintagestory.at/api/mod/<modid>).

installed.description: true if currently installed in the Mods/ folder. false = tracked only because it's the original/predecessor of an installed fork, per AGENTS.md line 3.

version.description: If installed=true: the version currently installed. If installed=false: the latest version we've observed upstream.

fork_of.description: modid of the original mod this one forks, if applicable. Omit if this isn't a fork. For a fork of multiple predecessors, use the primary/most direct one here and mention the others in checked.note.

forked_by.description: modids of installed/tracked forks of this mod. Omit if none. Inverse of fork_of on the forking entry.

patch_for.description: modid of the mod this one exists solely to patch/fix, per AGENTS.md line 4. Omit if not a patch mod. Remove this whole mod entry once the patch is no longer needed (i.e. the original fixes the bug).

checked.description: Point-in-time snapshots of what we verified on the mod's page, newest first. Append a new entry when a recheck turns up something substantive — a fork/keep decision, a newly found incompatibility, a meaningful observation ('we forked this years ago and it's still the right call' is worth keeping). Do NOT append routine version-bump noise like 'updated x to y' with nothing else to say — that belongs in AgentLogs/, not here. The array is the history; only add to it when there's something worth knowing later.

version.description: The mod version this entry's facts (known_incompatibilities, fork_decision, downloads, note) were true as of.

downloads.description: Download count as of this snapshot. Omit if unknown.

known_incompatibilities.description: Omit if none found as of this snapshot.

fork_decision.description: Why we're keeping/dropping this fork vs. its original, per AGENTS.md line 3 (per-mod decision, not automatic). Omit if fork_of isn't set, or if unchanged since the previous entry.

note.description: Any other free-text observation worth keeping. Omit if none.
